title: Yocan UNI Twist Universal Portable 510 Mod (taxes extra)
description:
Yocan UNI Twist Universal Portable Mod
Compatible with 510 Cartridges

The Yocan Uni Twist is just as great as it’s predecessors with an extra TWIST for people who would rather the simple turning knob instead of the button pressing and screens on the others. It is really easy to use, with variable voltage from 1.8V up to 4V. It is small and compact as always with a magnetic connector ring to connect to the cartridge and snap right into your Uni Twist!

Product Features:
– Twist Variable Voltage (1.8V-4.0V)
– Micro USB-C Charging
– Hanging Hole
– Adjustable and universal cartridge slot
Height and Width Adjustable

What’s Included:
-(1) Uni Twist Mod
-(1)Magnetic Connector ring
-(1) Type-C Cable
-(1) Instructions Manual
